benefit_pursued: Skill acquisition and retention after a sustained seizure response
observation_available: Two seizure-free children among 12 (E08), drugs and developmental course not in the abstract; no timed before/after in any WWOX report
inference_and_competing_alternative: Gain would favour a contribution of seizure control; a stable low level fits the pre-onset component or the baseline of genetic DEE
discriminating_measure: Dated within-child score on one continuous instrument before and after a sustained response (electroclinical, video-EEG confirmed), against the stratum slope
in_silico_feasible: Yes: tabulate stratum slopes from published cohorts to set the expected change [Audit: 'stratum slopes' not supported: A2's continuous data are arm-level or cross-sectional and the comparison holds only as a binary.]
needs_collaboration_or_experiment: Full text of the 12-child series or the published data of the series; no author or service contact by this module
changes_choice_of: Whether INV-10 stays a counts-only line or becomes a testable cohort question

observation_available: You 2024 shows events on video-EEG without home-observed seizures
inference_and_competing_alternative: Home-observed freedom overstates control; alternatively video-EEG captures events with no function consequence
discriminating_measure: Paired video-EEG event rate and parent diary at fixed times in any new report
in_silico_feasible: Yes: recode existing rows with a separate electrographic column
changes_choice_of: Which card endpoint is used for antiseizure comparisons

benefit_pursued: Seizure benefit of the ethosuximide result in the Wwox null
observation_available: One acute provoked-seizure experiment, floor-limited wild type (E24)
inference_and_competing_alternative: Late-phase suppression by a non-selective drug versus a Cav3-dependent effect
discriminating_measure: Same-day concurrent comparison with an interaction term and a second, mechanistically different agent (already designed in the T-type package)
changes_choice_of: Whether the ethosuximide row stays a comparator-field row [Audit: omits the null-pup direction of the ethosuximide result.]

benefit_pursued: Seizure and function benefit of cannabidiol, perampanel, ethosuximide in WWOX
observation_available: Exposures exist (E20, E21, E22, E26); no attributable outcome per compound; one designed cannabidiol cohort contains three WWOX patients
inference_and_competing_alternative: Exposure and continuation are not efficacy; polytherapy confounds
discriminating_measure: Per-compound response with co-therapy listed and a dated function measure, from the cohort data of the designed studies
in_silico_feasible: Limited: the published subgroup table only
needs_collaboration_or_experiment: Cerulli Irelli group data for the WWOX subgroup
changes_choice_of: Whether a compound is carried as studied or merely exposed

benefit_pursued: Safety of the white-matter MRI signal
observation_available: Population rate 18 of 64 in imaged vigabatrin-treated children of mixed aetiology; two selected WWOX cases
inference_and_competing_alternative: Drug effect versus background MRI findings of the disease
discriminating_measure: WWOX-specific denominator of imaged exposed and unexposed children with timing
in_silico_feasible: Partly: re-tabulate the cohort stratified by genetic aetiology (9 of 18 positives)
changes_choice_of: No autonomous exclusion of a therapy; flags the card only [Audit: omits prednisolone co-therapy (OR 4.07), dose and duration, and aetiology as competing explanations; a genetic re-tabulation needs the full text.]

benefit_pursued: Sleep, comfort, participation and caregiver burden
observation_available: None measured; caregiver global impression anchored to seizure reduction in LGS (E10)
inference_and_competing_alternative: Seizure reduction is a proxy for caregiver-rated benefit; the other benefits could move independently
discriminating_measure: A caregiver-reported measure with items outside seizures, collected before and after any change
needs_collaboration_or_experiment: Foundation survey extension or clinical collaboration
changes_choice_of: Whether benefits other than seizures can be claimed for any candidate

benefit_pursued: Separating drug action from seizure-mediated benefit
inference_and_competing_alternative: Direct action versus mediation through seizure control and co-therapy changes
discriminating_measure: Mediation analysis with seizure control as mediator in any cohort that records both
in_silico_feasible: Yes where individual-level published data exist
changes_choice_of: Whether a benefit beyond seizures may be attached to a compound card [Audit: E18 is adjusted (early seizure control, total ASM burden) and retrospective, not 'uncontrolled'; the adjustment variable is seizure control at one month only.]
